verdict.summary: The change correctly adds an independent SCOPE-DOC invariant on top of the existing whole-file workflow/golden pin. The checker applies the new validation on the live --root path, and the negative fixture removes the scope block from both workflow and golden so that the byte pin remains clean while SCOPE-DOC alone must fail; this makes the test non-vacuous. The workflow and generated golden remain byte-consistent, and both the self-test and live guard pass. No correctness, security, or test-validity defect was found.
